capabilities: : Navigate files and tags using modal keys
: Perform file operations (rename, delete, copy, paste)
: Filter files and tags using fuzzy search
: Preview Markdown, images, Canvas, and Base notes
disambiguation: Not a standard file browser; it is a pop-up drawer designed for modal navigation and live content preview.
extras: Status: young but daily-driven. Expect sharp edges; issues and PRs welcome.
intentEvidence: A pop-up file and tag explorer for Obsidian with modal, vim-style navigation and a live preview pane
problem: Standard file and tag navigation in Obsidian lacks a powerful, keyboard-first, modal interface for bulk operations and live previews.

relations.evidence: inspired by the snacks.nvim / neo-tree explorer experience.
works alongside vim plugins such as Vim Motions

summary: A pop-up file and tag explorer for Obsidian that uses modal, Vim-style navigation and includes a live preview pane.
